title: Free credit reports - federal rights
facts: Federal law gives consumers access to free credit reports from the nationwide credit reporting companies through the authorized AnnualCreditReport.com service.
AnnualCreditReport.com is the federally authorized source established for free reports; consumers should distinguish it from lookalike sites.
Checking your own credit report does not lower your credit score.
A credit report and a credit score are different products; the federal right to a free report does not automatically mean every score is free.
